description:
We are seeking a dedicated Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This vital leadership role supports the Director of Nursing in overseeing clinical operations, ensuring the highest standards of patient care, and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff. The ideal candidate will be instrumental in maintaining regulatory compliance and driving continuous quality improvement initiatives.

As an ADON, you will play a key role in staff supervision, development, and scheduling, contributing to a cohesive and efficient nursing team. This position offers a competitive annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, reflecting your experience and commitment to excellence in long-term care.
requirements: Previous experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Demonstrated leadership and supervisory experience in nursing
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
Knowledge of state and federal regulations governing skilled nursing facilities
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, based on experience and qualifications.
